C.elegans.description: C. elegans embryo WT-EMB08 (Li et al. 2019), with the positions of its cells and, mapped on them, 104 tissue-reporter recordings of the RNAi screen of Du et al. 2015

C.elegans_wild_types.description: 30 wild-type C. elegans embryos lineaged by the Bao lab with a tissue reporter (10 per strain: pha-4, nhr-25, cnd-1), as a LineageTreeManager, xz-compressed

C.elegans_RNAi_screen.description: The 1,322 C. elegans embryos of the RNAi screen of Du et al. 2015 (204 genes, tissue reporters pha-4, nhr-25, cnd-1), as a LineageTreeManager, xz-compressed
